observations: Photos 0 and 1: a white industrial flatbed straight stitch (lockstitch) sewing machine head mounted on a white table with metal legs, a thread stand and a foot pedal.
Photos 0 and 1: 'EMEL' badge on the machine arm; a small plate on the arm reads 'EM 8500' as far as the resolution allows.
Photo 1: 'EMEL' is also printed on the table top edge; photo 0 and 1 show 'EMEL' on the red pedal mat.
Photo 0: a motor is mounted under the table and an OFF/ON switch box is fixed to the table front right.
Photos 0 and 1: a box marked 'EMEL CLUTCH MOTOR' with 'CE' sits on the floor beside the table; it may be the motor's empty box.
Photos 0 and 1: machine and table look clean with no visible rust or broken parts; tape measure, scissors, tape and bobbins lie on the table.
No photo shows the machine running, stitching, the bobbin area, the motor plate, or the oil sump; the room's wall is damp stained and the floor cluttered.
Both photos carry a 'Posted on Jiji' watermark and a seller name.

identity.kind: industrial straight stitch sewing machine with table and clutch motor

claims.evidence: Age cannot be shown in a photo; a purchase receipt would only hint at it. Clean finish in photos 0 and 1 is consistent with light use.
Photos 0 and 1 show an industrial flatbed head on an industrial table with an under-table motor.
No clip of the motor running or the machine stitching fabric.

risks.risk: Motor may not run, may hum, or the clutch may slip; the machine may skip stitches, have timing problems or a seized hook.
risks.proof: A clip with sound of the motor switched on and the machine sewing a straight seam on fabric, then a close-up of the stitch on both sides.

risks.risk: The motor under the table may be a different or weaker unit than the boxed clutch motor, or the box may be empty.
risks.proof: A close photo of the motor plate under the table, and a photo of the box opened.
risks.if_unproven: as the machine with the motor seen, no spare motor

risks.risk: Bobbin case, bobbins, presser foot or other accessories may be missing or worn.
risks.proof: A photo of the bobbin area with the slide plate open and the bobbin case in place.
risks.if_unproven: as missing bobbin case and accessories

risks.risk: Model plate read at low resolution may be a different variant.
risks.proof: A close photo of the model plate on the arm.
risks.if_unproven: as the basic Emel straight stitch head

risks.risk: Photos may not be of the unit being sold.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give.

proof_requests: Clip with sound of the motor running and the machine sewing a straight seam on fabric.
Close photo of the model plate on the arm and the motor plate under the table.
Photo of the bobbin area with the slide plate open.
Photo of the machine with a handwritten code and today's date.
Photo of the clutch motor box opened to show whether it holds a motor.
response.reason: The 'EMEL' badge and 'EM 8500' plate in photo 0 identify an Emel industrial straight stitch machine on its table with motor, so it can be priced at its worst case as not working. A running and stitching clip would raise it.
